body.text: What clear-liquid and protein-broth diet is required in Week 1?

Immediately after gastric sleeve or gastric bypass surgery, surgeons prescribe a strict Stage 1 clear-liquid protocol to protect the healing staple line and prevent dehydration. Patients sip small amounts of still water, fat-free strained broth, sugar-free gelatin, and decaffeinated tea throughout the day, avoiding carbonation, caffeine, and added sugars entirely.

Clinical guidance from the [American Society for Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery (ASMBS)](https://asmbs.org/patients/life-after-bariatric-surgery/) emphasizes reaching 64 ounces (roughly 1.9 liters) of daily fluid and progressing toward 60 to 100 grams of protein per day as tolerated. Peer-reviewed [NIH / PMC bariatric nutrition literature](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7455579/) confirms that low-sugar clear liquids typically begin within 24 hours of surgery, while the [Mayo Clinic gastric bypass diet guide](https://www.mayoclinic.org/tests-procedures/gastric-bypass-surgery/in-depth/gastric-bypass-diet/art-20048472) notes that broth and sugar-free clear fluids form the foundation before moving to full liquids.

body.text: What warning signs (fever, tachycardia, severe pain) require immediate hospital return?

Leaving the hospital for a nearby Istanbul recovery hotel does not end surgical risk, particularly during the first 72 hours to two weeks. Persistent tachycardia (a resting heart rate above 100 beats per minute), fever, worsening abdominal pain, or inability to keep fluids down are red flags requiring immediate surgical evaluation.

Both the [NHS weight loss surgery complications guide](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/weight-loss-surgery/complications/) and [Johns Hopkins Medicine anastomotic leak guidance](https://www.hopkinsmedicine.org/health/treatment-tests-and-therapies/risks-of-gastric-bypass-surgery-anastomotic-leaking) list rapid heart rate, fever, severe abdominal pain, left shoulder pain, fast breathing, and low urine output as urgent signs of a potential staple-line leak or blood clot. Never wait until a scheduled morning check-up if these appear. ITO maps the fastest ambulance and private transfer route from your bariatric recovery hotel in Istanbul back to your hospital's 24/7 emergency department before discharge.
How is long-term dietitian follow-up structured from abroad?

Safe bariatric recovery continues for 12 months and beyond after you fly home, shifting from liquids to pureed foods, soft textures, and lifelong vitamin monitoring. Before you depart Istanbul, your hospital's bariatric dietitian should hand over a staged English nutrition plan, supplement schedule, and scheduled telehealth check-in dates.

The [NHS post-surgery recovery framework](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/weight-loss-surgery/recovering/) highlights small portions, slow chewing, and ongoing blood-test monitoring for iron, vitamin B12, folate, vitamin D, and calcium. ITO ensures you leave Türkiye with printed and digital copies of your operative summary, discharge medication list, and dietitian contact schedule so your home-country GP or local registered dietitian can continue lab monitoring without gaps.

faq.q: Can I drink traditional Turkish lentil soup during Week 1 in Istanbul?
faq.a: No. Turkish mercimek çorbası is thick, contains fiber, oil, and spices, and does not qualify as a Stage 1 clear liquid. Stick strictly to fat-free, double-strained clear broth unless your surgeon explicitly clears smooth liquids.

faq.q: How many nights should I stay in a bariatric recovery hotel in Istanbul?
faq.a: Most surgical teams require two to three inpatient nights followed by two to four hotel nights near the hospital for leak checks and hydration monitoring before clearing you to fly.

faq.q: Should I pack protein powder in my luggage for Türkiye?
faq.a: Yes. Unflavored or clear whey isolate packets approved by your dietitian travel easily in checked luggage and prevent last-minute pharmacy searches when local brands differ in sweetness or ingredients.

faq.q: Can ITO recommend a bariatric surgeon or adjust my meal plan?
faq.a: No. Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions, including every dietary stage transition and clinical clearance.

faq.q: What hotel districts work best for bariatric recovery in Istanbul?
faq.a: Choose a quiet hotel within 10 to 15 minutes of your surgical hospital—such as Şişli, Beşiktaş, Maslak, or Ataşehir—rather than steep historic streets in Sultanahmet.
